prompt: I need a list of tips to help my 3 year old toddler eat food, he's currently not eating anywhere near enough
response: To encourage eating, make meal times fun and engaging, using colorful plates and playful food arrangements. Offer a wide variety of foods in small portions to keep meals interesting. Avoid pressuring your child to eat, as this can create negative associations with food. It's okay to let your child skip a meal if they're not hungry, as they will eat when they are truly hungry.
